name: statement-of-work
title: DRAFT: service statement of work
for_each: select id,code from scopes order by code

sections.title: Estimate details
sections.note: Draft estimate for review. No customer acceptance or dispatch is recorded.

sections.title: Work and acceptance
sections.sql: select name,phase,resource,total_hours,description,acceptance,total_sell_cents from line_costs where scope_id=$1 order by phase,code

sections.title: Service wording
sections.sql: select i.name as service,entry.key as field,entry.value as wording from scope_items i cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(i.language) entry where i.scope_id=$1 and trim(entry.value)<>'' order by i.code,entry.key

sections.title: Estimate total
sections.sql: select currency,revenue_cents,unpriced from scope_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,resolved_on,evidence from assumptions where scope_id=$1 order by code

name: delivery-handover
title: DRAFT: internal delivery handover
for_each: select id,code from scopes order by code

sections.title: Work breakdown and estimate basis
sections.sql: select name,phase,resource,total_hours,acceptance,evidence from line_costs where scope_id=$1 order by phase,code

sections.title: Open assumptions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due from assumptions where scope_id=$1 and resolved_on is null

sections.title: Revision approvals
sections.sql: select sub.revision,ap.kind,ap.actor,ap.evidence,ap.exception_reason from submissions sub join approvals ap on ap.submission_id=sub.id where sub.scope_id=$1 order by sub.revision,ap.kind
